summary: This bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to prohibit the issuance of nonimmigrant student visas to nationals of the People's Republic of China for the purpose of conducting research or pursuing a course of study.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to prohibit the admission of Chinese nationals as nonimmigrant students. This is a central and explicit restriction on a specific type of immigration, clearly aligning with a secure borders stance by limiting who can enter the country.
